dedupe_keys.name: historical gridded snow water equivalent over the northern hemisphere from remote sensing and land surface models

description: Historical gridded snow water equivalent over the Northern Hemisphere from remote sensing and land surface models is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Datasets of daily and monthly snow water equivalent (SWE) over the Northern Hemisphere (excluding Greenland) were constructed using a multi-dataset approach for the time period 1981-2020. The data are on a regular 0.5-degree grid, with a threshold maximum of 2000mm. The general methodology for the creation of these datasets follows that of Mudryk et al. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Its tags are Climate, Snow, Remote sensing, Models, snow water equivalent. It offers 2 resource(s) in NETCDF. The portal shows 2025-10-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
